description:
"Too Much Is Never Enough" - Jordan Belfort rises from outer borough striver to founding the firm Stratton Oakmont, notorious for its high-pressure phone sales, lavish pay days, and prostitute-and-drug-fueled parties. But as investors complain, the FBI takes notice.

While The Wolf of Wall Street turned Jordan Belfort into the face of glamourous excess, this three-part documentary uses never-before seen videos, photos, and insider interviews to reveal the explosive true story of Belfort's rise and dramatic fall.
